member.name: T:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior
member.summary: Specifies how controls behave in terms of applying variants.
member.remarks:
When set on a , the value specifies how child controls of a are assigned a variant size based on the current value of the property, but only when the parent's 's is Stacking. The control is intended to be used directly as a child of a control. In this scenario, the parent automatically sets the property to the group's variant size, and therefore enables the behavior specified by this enumeration when the parent's 's is Stacking.
Alternatively, when set on a control such as a button (e.g., ), the value specifies the allowed variant sizes when on a ribbon in Simplified layout mode or a toolbar. Note that these scenarios do not allow large variant sizes.

member.name: F:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior.All
member.summary:
Controls will use all variant sizes. This option provides the largest number of variants for controls.
When in a , controls use a Large variant size when the of the is Large. They change to a Medium variant size when the of the is Medium. They change to a Small variant size when the of the is Small.

member.name: F:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior.NeverSmall
member.summary:
Controls will use the Large and Medium variant sizes.
When in a , controls use a Large variant size when the of the is Large. They change to a Medium variant size when the of the is Medium or Small.

member.name: F:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior.NeverMedium
member.summary:
Controls will use the Large and Small variant sizes.
When in a , controls use a Large variant size when the of the is Large. They change to a Small variant size when the of the is Medium or Small.

member.name: F:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior.NeverLarge
member.summary:
Controls will use the Medium and Small variant sizes.
When in a , controls use a Medium variant size when the of the is Large or Medium. They change to a Small variant size when the of the is Small.

member.name: F:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior.AlwaysLarge
member.summary:
Controls will only use the Large variant size.
When in a , controls always use a Large variant size no matter what the of the is. This option is generally the same as not wrapping controls in a at all, but is useful if wanting to support separators around a set of controls.

member.name: F:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior.AlwaysMedium
member.summary:
Controls will only use the Medium variant size.
When in a , controls always use a Medium variant size no matter what the of the is.

member.name: F:ActiproSoftware.Windows.Controls.Bars.ItemVariantBehavior.AlwaysSmall
member.summary:

member.summary: Ensures that the layout of the specified child control is resumed.
member.remarks: This method is necessary because WPF will stop an control from being able to be measured once it has been removed from a visual tree and until it reenters another visual tree. This scenario can occur when a control is moved to an overflow panel and prevents measurements from being returned properly in certain scenarios. By resuming the layout, the problem is resolved, however it takes reflection to do so.
